title: Orchard and Harbor
author: Freya Winterbourne
blurb: Oscar Thackeray, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
